tasks.title: Keep pronoun reference clear in a shared project: read and notice
tasks.objective: Resolve pronouns from grammar and discourse, not simply from the nearest noun. Celui-ci can resume a named participant; en avoir besoin resumes a complement introduced by de.
tasks.context: Julie prête son ordinateur à Karim pour préparer une affiche avec Ana. Quand Ana arrive, il lui explique que Julie en a besoin avant dix-sept heures. Ana propose de terminer le texte sur son propre appareil et de l’envoyer ensuite à Karim. Celui-ci accepte, mais demande que le fichier reste modifiable. Le soir, Julie remercie Karim de lui avoir rendu l’ordinateur à temps. Dans ce récit, l’ordinateur de Julie et l’appareil d’Ana ne doivent pas être confondus ; le pronom le de l’envoyer renvoie au texte, pas à un appareil.

tasks.title: Keep pronoun reference clear in a shared project: transfer and assess
tasks.objective: Transfer the module language to an unfamiliar situation and review comprehension, writing and interaction separately.
tasks.context:
Write 140–170 French words describing three people sharing two objects and a document. Keep the reference chain clear; replace an ambiguous pronoun with a name. Explain the sequence aloud and ask the Tutor to identify who owns what before you confirm.

Revision: retrieve the three contextual expressions without the model on a later day; correct saved errors and reuse them in a new scenario.

Review task fulfilment, source fidelity, grammar, vocabulary, organisation and interaction/repair separately. Treat spelling extraction as supported practice, not proficiency evidence. Optional AI feedback is advisory. Independent human language/phonetic review and empirical calibration remain pending.
